# CVar reference

<!-- Generated by Documentation/Tools/GenerateCVarReference.mjs. Do not edit by hand: change the
     descriptions in Source/Renderer_DX12/EngineCVars.cpp and run the script again. -->

Every console variable (cvar) the engine registers: **563** settings in **35** groups. Each one is the same value as a control in a settings window, so changing it in the Console and moving the slider do exactly the same thing.

## Using cvars

Type into the **Console** (**Windows → Console**):

```
rtgi.maxbounces          show the current value, its range and its default
rtgi.maxbounces 3        set it
list fog                 every cvar whose name or description mentions "fog"
help taa.enabled         describe one cvar
reset rtgi.maxbounces    back to its default
reset all                every cvar back to its default
dumpcvars                every cvar and its current value
```

| Type | What you can type |
| --- | --- |
| **bool** | `true` / `false`, `1` / `0`, `on` / `off`, `yes` / `no` |
| **int** | A whole number inside the range |
| **float** | A number inside the range, such as `0.25` |
| **enum** | One of the listed names, or its number (shown in brackets) |

A value outside the range is **rejected, not clamped**, so a typo never silently does something else. The **Default** column is the value the engine starts with, which is what `reset` restores. A level that saves its own settings overrides it when it loads, so the value you see in a level may differ. Settings that belong to a level are saved with it; see [1. How Ptero works](01-How-Ptero-Works.md#levels-entities-and-components) for which ones.

**Units**: distances in metres, angles in degrees, times in seconds, light in lux or lumens, exposure in EV100, unless the description says otherwise.

## Renderer

How it works: [1. How Ptero works](01-How-Ptero-Works.md).

| CVar | What it does | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `r.disneybrdf` | Disney principled BRDF (off: Lambert + Cook-Torrance). | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `r.grid` | Draws the viewport ground grid. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `r.viewdistance` | Camera far plane in metres. Nothing further away than this is drawn. | `500.0` – `100000.0` | `8000` |
| `r.wireframe` | Draws scene geometry as wireframe. | `true` / `false` | `false` |

## Virtualized geometry

How it works: [4. Components](04-Components.md#virtualized-geometry).

| CVar | What it does | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vg.all` | Draw every eligible mesh through virtualized geometry, whatever its own flag says. Not saved with the level. | `true` / `false` | `false` |
| `vg.backfaceculling` | Skip clusters whose every triangle faces away from the camera. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `vg.debugview` | Colours virtualized geometry by cluster, instance, or DAG level (LOD). | `off` (0), `clusters` (1), `instances` (2), `lod` (3) | `off` |
| `vg.enabled` | Virtualized geometry for meshes flagged Virtualized Geometry. Off draws them with their ordinary LODs. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `vg.errorthreshold` | Largest simplification error a cluster may show, in pixels. Lower is sharper and costs more triangles. | `0.1` – `16.0` | `1.0` |
| `vg.freeze` | Freeze culling and LOD selection at the current camera, then fly around to inspect what was selected. | `true` / `false` | `false` |
| `vg.meshshaders` | Rasterise clusters with mesh shaders when the GPU has them. Off forces the vertex shader path. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `vg.occlusion` | Two-pass hierarchical-Z occlusion culling of clusters. Inactive with MSAA. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `vg.shadows` | Virtualized meshes cast shadows from their clusters. Off draws their shadows the ordinary way. | `true` / `false` | `true` |

## Ray-traced GI (RTGI)

How it works: [7. Global illumination, reflections and ambient occlusion](07-Global-Illumination.md#rtgi-ray-traced-global-illumination).

| CVar | What it does | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rtgi.accumulationblend` | Weight of the current frame in the non-NRD accumulator. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `1.0` |
| `rtgi.blas.loderror` | Simplification error, in metres, of the nearest ray tracing tier. | `0.0` – `0.1` | `0.005` |
| `rtgi.blas.tierdistance` | Distance, in metres, where the second ray tracing detail tier starts; each further tier starts 4x further out. | `1.0` – `200.0` | `15.0` |
| `rtgi.blas.tiers` | Ray tracing detail tiers by distance, each with 4x the error of the one before. | whole number, `1` – `3` | `3` |
| `rtgi.blas.virtualgeometry` | Ray trace virtualized meshes against a simplified cut through their cluster DAG. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `rtgi.colorleak` | How much surface colour bleeds into the bounce. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `1.0` |
| `rtgi.debugview` | Replaces the image with one RTGI intermediate. | `off` (0), `radiance` (1), `luminance` (2), `reservoir` (3), `deterministic_probe` (4), `flat_white` (5), `world_normal` (6), `world_position` (7), `hit_distance` (8), `ray_direction` (9) | `off` |
| `rtgi.depththreshold` | Relative depth difference above which a reused sample is rejected. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.1` |
| `rtgi.diffuseresolution` | Diffuse GI trace resolution divisor: 1 full, 2 half, 4 quarter. | whole number, `1` – `4` | `1` |
| `rtgi.enabled` | Ray-traced global illumination. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `rtgi.gi.intensity` | Multiplier on the final indirect contribution. | `0.0` – `16.0` | `1.0` |
| `rtgi.maxbounces` | Indirect bounces per path. More bounces fill dark interiors better and cost more. | whole number, `1` – `8` | `2` |
| `rtgi.maxhistorylength` | Frames a temporal reservoir may accumulate. | whole number, `1` – `200` | `10` |
| `rtgi.nee` | Next-event estimation: sample lights directly at each hit. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `rtgi.nee.lightsamples` | Lights per bounce hit with stochastic light sampling. | whole number, `1` – `4` | `2` |
| `rtgi.nee.stochastic` | Test the shadows of a few lights per bounce hit, picked by contribution, instead of every light. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `rtgi.nee.vsm` | Answer next-event visibility from the virtual shadow map where it has a fine enough page; trace a ray elsewhere. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `rtgi.nee.vsmmaxtexel` | Coarsest shadow-map texel, in metres, trusted at a bounce hit; coarser pages leak through thin walls. | `0.001` – `1.0` | `0.04` |
| `rtgi.normalthreshold` | Normal dot-product below which a reused sample is rejected. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.5` |
| `rtgi.nrd` | Denoise with NVIDIA RELAX instead of the built-in temporal filter. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `rtgi.nrd.atrousiterations` | RELAX a-trous blur passes. More passes give smoother, blurrier GI. | whole number, `0` – `8` | `5` |
| `rtgi.nrd.disocclusionthreshold` | RELAX disocclusion sensitivity; higher keeps more history through motion. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.2` |
| `rtgi.nrd.maxaccumulationtime` | RELAX history length, in seconds. | `0.0` – `5.0` | `0.5` |
| `rtgi.nrd.sharpen` | RELAX output sharpening. Restores detail the denoiser softened. | `0.0` – `2.0` | `0.35` |
| `rtgi.radianceclamp` | Ceiling on a single sample's radiance; lower kills fireflies and dims bright bounces. | `0.0` – `1000.0` | `10.0` |
| `rtgi.rays.brightness` | GI ray brightness; 1 is about a sunlit white surface. | `0.0` – `100.0` | `1.0` |
| `rtgi.rays.camera` | Draw the camera ray to each traced pixel. | `true` / `false` | `false` |
| `rtgi.rays.colour` | GI ray colouring. | `bounce` (0), `radiance` (1) | `bounce` |
| `rtgi.rays.freeze` | Stop capturing GI rays and keep drawing the captured ones. | `true` / `false` | `false` |
| `rtgi.rays.history` | Frames of GI rays kept on screen. | whole number, `1` – `256` | `1` |
| `rtgi.rays.misslength` | Metres drawn of GI rays that escape to the sky. | `0.0` – `1000.0` | `4.0` |
| `rtgi.rays.pattern` | Which pixels trace visible rays. | `grid` (0), `centre` (1) | `grid` |
| `rtgi.rays.shadow` | Draw the sun shadow ray from each bounce hit. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `rtgi.rays.shadowlength` | Metres drawn of sun shadow rays. | `0.0` – `1000.0` | `1.0` |
| `rtgi.rays.show` | Draw the GI paths of a sparse set of pixels over the image. | `true` / `false` | `false` |
| `rtgi.rays.spacing` | Pixels between traced pixels in the grid pattern. | whole number, `8` – `512` | `64` |
| `rtgi.rays.width` | GI ray line width in pixels. | `0.5` – `8.0` | `1.5` |
| `rtgi.raysperpixel` | GI rays traced per pixel per frame. | whole number, `1` – `32` | `1` |
| `rtgi.spatialradius` | Spatial reuse search radius in pixels. | `1.0` – `200.0` | `20.0` |
| `rtgi.spatialreuse` | ReSTIR spatial reservoir reuse. Unused while the NRD denoiser is on. | `true` / `false` | `false` |
| `rtgi.spatialsamples` | Neighbours consulted during spatial reuse. | whole number, `1` – `32` | `4` |
| `rtgi.specular.enabled` | Ray-traced specular (glossy reflections) on top of diffuse GI. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `rtgi.specular.intensity` | Multiplier on ray-traced specular. | `0.0` – `16.0` | `0.10` |
| `rtgi.specular.roughnessthreshold` | Surfaces rougher than this get no ray-traced specular. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.6` |
| `rtgi.specularresolution` | Reflection trace resolution divisor: 1 full, 2 half. | whole number, `1` – `2` | `1` |
| `rtgi.temporalreuse` | ReSTIR temporal reservoir reuse. Unused while the NRD denoiser is on. | `true` / `false` | `false` |

| `probes.spacing` | Distance between probes in the finest cascade, in metres. | `0.1` – `100.0` | `2.0` |
| `probes.specular.enabled` | Ray-traced specular reflections in probe GI mode. | `true` / `false` | `true` |

| `probes.traceresolution` | Share of probes traced per frame, as a divisor: 1 all, 2 half, 4 quarter. | whole number, `1` – `4` | `1` |

## Voxel GI

How it works: [7. Global illumination, reflections and ambient occlusion](07-Global-Illumination.md#voxel-gi).

| CVar | What it does | Values | Default |

| `voxelgi.gi.intensity` | Multiplier on the voxel diffuse GI. | `0.0` – `16.0` | `1.0` |
| `voxelgi.halfres` | Trace at half resolution and upsample. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `voxelgi.levels` | Nested clipmap levels, each twice the size of the one inside it. | whole number, `2` – `6` | `5` |
| `voxelgi.localshadows` | Trace local lights' shadows through the voxels when lighting them. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `voxelgi.lodbias` | Mesh LOD voxelized into the finest level; coarser levels add one per level. | whole number, `0` – `8` | `1` |
| `voxelgi.maxdistance` | Furthest a cone travels, in metres, before it takes the sky. | `1.0` – `1000.0` | `60.0` |
| `voxelgi.multibounce` | Share of the previous bounce fed back into the voxels; 0 = one bounce. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `1.0` |
| `voxelgi.resolution` | Voxels along each edge of a clipmap level (32, 64, 96 or 128). | whole number, `32` – `128` | `64` |
| `voxelgi.specular.enabled` | Cone traced reflections. Reflections traced through the voxels; SSR takes over where it finds a hit. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `voxelgi.specular.intensity` | Multiplier on the voxel reflections. | `0.0` – `16.0` | `1.0` |
| `voxelgi.specular.roughnessthreshold` | Surfaces rougher than this get no reflection cone. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.8` |
| `voxelgi.sunshadows` | Trace the sun's shadow through the voxels when lighting them. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `voxelgi.surfaceoffset` | Cone start offset from the surface, in voxels. | `0.0` – `4.0` | `1.5` |
| `voxelgi.temporalblend` | Share of the voxels' new lighting taken per frame; lower is steadier. 1 = no smoothing. | `0.01` – `1.0` | `0.15` |
| `voxelgi.voxelsize` | Voxel edge, in metres, in the finest clipmap level. | `0.05` – `2.0` | `0.2` |

## Ray-traced ambient occlusion

How it works: [7. Global illumination, reflections and ambient occlusion](07-Global-Illumination.md#ambient-occlusion).

| CVar | What it does | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rtao.debugview` | RTAO debug visualisation. 0 = final AO, 1 = raw noisy AO, 2 = denoised AO. | whole number, `0` – `4` | `0` |

## Screen-space reflections

How it works: [7. Global illumination, reflections and ambient occlusion](07-Global-Illumination.md#screen-space-reflections).

| CVar | What it does | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ssr.debugview` | SSR debug visualisation. Ray march: 0 = composite, 1 = reflection only, 2 = confidence. FidelityFX: 0 = composite, 1 = denoised reflection, 2 = raw reflection. | whole number, `0` – `4` | `0` |
| `ssr.edgefadestart` | Screen fraction at which reflections start fading at the border. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.85` |

| `ssr.maxdistance` | Longest reflection ray, in metres. | `1.0` – `1000.0` | `60.0` |

| `ssr.maxsteps` | March steps before a ray is abandoned. | whole number, `1` – `512` | `48` |
| `ssr.refinesteps` | Binary-search steps used to refine a hit. | whole number, `0` – `32` | `6` |
| `ssr.sssr.maxtraversal` | FidelityFX: traversal steps per ray. | whole number, `1` – `1024` | `128` |
| `ssr.sssr.minoccupancy` | FidelityFX: stop a wave once this few rays remain. | whole number, `0` – `64` | `4` |
| `ssr.sssr.mostdetailedmip` | FidelityFX: depth pyramid level glossy rays start on. | whole number, `0` – `4` | `0` |
| `ssr.sssr.samplesperquad` | FidelityFX: glossy rays per 2x2 quad (1, 2 or 4). | whole number, `1` – `4` | `1` |
| `ssr.sssr.temporalstability` | FidelityFX: history clipping; higher is steadier, lower ghosts less. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.7` |
| `ssr.sssr.thickness` | FidelityFX: how far below the depth buffer a hit may land, in metres. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.015` |
| `ssr.sssr.varianceguided` | FidelityFX: re-trace pixels whose history is unstable. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `ssr.sssr.variancethreshold` | FidelityFX: variance above which a skipped pixel is re-traced. | `0.0` – `0.01` | `0.0` |
| `ssr.stepgrowth` | Multiplier applied to each successive step. | `1.0` – `2.0` | `1.05` |
| `ssr.stepsize` | Length of the first march step, in metres. | `0.001` – `10.0` | `0.25` |
| `ssr.technique` | Reflection tracer. `raymarch` = one sharp ray per pixel; `fidelityfx` = AMD SSSR, blurred glossy reflections with a denoiser. | `raymarch` (0), `fidelityfx` (1) | `raymarch` |
| `ssr.thickness` | Assumed depth-buffer thickness when testing a hit. | `0.001` – `10.0` | `0.5` |

## Time of day, sky, sun and moon

How it works: [6. Lighting, sky and time of day](06-Lighting.md#time-of-day).

| CVar | What it does | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tod.adaptationev100max` | Darkest EV100 eye adaptation may reach. | `-16.0` – `16.0` | `1.0` |
| `tod.adaptationev100min` | Brightest EV100 eye adaptation may reach. | `-16.0` – `16.0` | `-7.5` |
| `tod.adaptationstrength` | Fraction of the metered difference eye adaptation follows. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.8` |
| `tod.controlexposure` | Time of day decides the tonemapper's EV100. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `tod.dayev100` | EV100 with the sun high. Used when tod.controlexposure is on. Higher = darker. | `-16.0` – `16.0` | `-2.0` |
| `tod.enabled` | Sun, sky ambient, procedural sky and clouds as one system. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `tod.eyeadaptation` | Adapt the time-of-day exposure to what the camera sees. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `tod.groundalbedo` | Ground albedo; tints the sky near the horizon. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.1` |
| `tod.latitude` | Latitude in degrees north; the noon sun stands at 90 minus this. | `-89.0` – `89.0` | `30.0` |
| `tod.moon` | The moon lights the scene while the sun is down. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `tod.moonintensitylux` | Full-moon illuminance in lux. | `0.0` – `20000.0` | `5000.0` |
| `tod.moonphase` | Moon phase: 0 new, 0.5 full. 0.25 = first quarter, 0.75 = last quarter. Also sets when the moon rises. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.5` |
| `tod.moonsize` | Apparent size of the moon disc. | `0.1` – `10.0` | `1.0` |
| `tod.nightev100` | EV100 once the sun is 12 degrees down. | `-16.0` – `16.0` | `-5.25` |
| `tod.nightskyintensitylux` | Sky ambient at night, in lux. | `0.0` – `20000.0` | `30.0` |
| `tod.northoffset` | Rotates the sun path, moon and stars about the vertical, in degrees. | `-180.0` – `180.0` | `0.0` |
| `tod.overrideskycolor` | Use the manual sky colour instead of the Hosek-Wilkie one. | `true` / `false` | `false` |
| `tod.overridesuncolor` | Use the manual sun colour instead of the Hosek-Wilkie one. | `true` / `false` | `false` |
| `tod.skycolor.b` | Manual sky colour, blue (linear). | `0.0` – `10.0` | `1.00` |
| `tod.skycolor.g` | Manual sky colour, green (linear). | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.45` |
| `tod.skycolor.r` | Manual sky colour, red (linear). | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.25` |
| `tod.skyintensitylux` | Sky ambient intensity in lux. | `0.0` – `200000.0` | `20000.0` |
| `tod.starfield` | Where the stars come from. `procedural` = sharp twinkling stars; `texture` = the real sky from a star map; `both` = map for the Milky Way, procedural for the sharp points. | `procedural` (0), `texture` (1), `both` (2) | `texture` |
| `tod.starintensity` | Star brightness multiplier. | `0.0` – `20.0` | `1.0` |
| `tod.stars` | Star field in the night sky. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `tod.suncolor.b` | Manual sun colour, blue (linear). | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.80` |
| `tod.suncolor.g` | Manual sun colour, green (linear). | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.95` |
| `tod.suncolor.r` | Manual sun colour, red (linear). | `0.0` – `10.0` | `1.00` |
| `tod.sunintensitylux` | Sun intensity in lux; real noon sun is about 100000. | `0.0` – `400000.0` | `120000.0` |
| `tod.sunsetev100` | EV100 with the sun on the horizon. | `-16.0` – `16.0` | `-3.5` |
| `tod.time` | Time of day in hours; noon is 12. | `0.0` – `24.0` | `12.0` |
| `tod.turbidity` | Atmospheric turbidity: 2 very clear, 10 heavy haze. | `1.0` – `10.0` | `2.5` |

## Wind

| `wind.enabled` | Scene-wide wind, shared by rain and vegetation. | `true` / `false` | `true` |

| `wind.gustamplitude` | Peak extra speed contributed by gusts, m/s. | `0.0` – `60.0` | `2.5` |

## Volumetric fog

How it works: [9. Outdoor worlds](09-Outdoor-Worlds.md#volumetric-fog).

| CVar | What it does | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fog.anisotropy` | Henyey-Greenstein g: positive scatters forward. | `-0.99` – `0.99` | `0.5` |
| `fog.baseheight` | Height at which the density falloff starts, in metres. | `-1000.0` – `10000.0` | `0.0` |
| `fog.color.b` | Fog scattering colour, blue. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `1.0` |
| `fog.color.g` | Fog scattering colour, green. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `1.0` |
| `fog.color.r` | Fog scattering colour, red. Colour components are linear; 1, 1, 1 is neutral white. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `1.0` |
| `fog.debugview` | Volumetric fog debug visualisation. | whole number, `0` – `4` | `0` |
| `fog.density` | Extinction per metre. A ray of length d keeps e^(-density x d) of its light. 0.02 is light haze, 0.1 thick fog. | `0.0` – `2.0` | `0.02` |
| `fog.depthslices` | Froxel slices along the view ray. | whole number, `8` – `256` | `64` |
| `fog.emissive.b` | Fog self-emission, blue. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.0` |
| `fog.emissive.g` | Fog self-emission, green. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.0` |
| `fog.emissive.intensity` | Multiplier on fog self-emission. | `0.0` – `100.0` | `0.0` |
| `fog.emissive.r` | Fog self-emission, red. Light the fog gives off by itself (glowing mist); 0 = none. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.0` |
| `fog.enabled` | Froxel volumetric fog. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `fog.froxeltilesize` | Froxel width in pixels; smaller is sharper and costlier. | whole number, `2` – `32` | `8` |
| `fog.heightfalloff` | Exponential density falloff with height; 0 is uniform. | `0.0` – `2.0` | `0.0` |
| `fog.maxdistance` | Furthest fogged distance, in metres. | `1.0` – `10000.0` | `100.0` |
| `fog.startdistance` | Nearest fogged distance, in metres. | `0.0` – `1000.0` | `0.1` |

## Volumetric clouds

How it works: [9. Outdoor worlds](09-Outdoor-Worlds.md#volumetric-clouds).

| CVar | What it does | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clouds.ambientintensityscale` | Multiplier on sky ambient reaching the clouds. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `1.0` |
| `clouds.anvilbias` | Spreads cloud tops outward into anvils. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.25` |
| `clouds.basenoisescale` | Base shape noise wavelength, in metres. | `100.0` – `200000.0` | `24000.0` |
| `clouds.cloudtopoffset` | Wind shear applied towards the cloud top, in metres. | `0.0` – `5000.0` | `350.0` |
| `clouds.cloudtype` | 0 stratus, 1 cumulonimbus. 0 = flat stratus, 0.5 = cumulus, 1 = towering cumulonimbus. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.50` |
| `clouds.coverage` | Fraction of sky covered. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.55` |
| `clouds.curlstrength` | Curl-noise warp applied to the detail. | `0.0` – `4.0` | `0.60` |
| `clouds.debugview` | Cloud debug visualisation. 0 = composite, 1 = luminance, 2 = transmittance, 3 = coverage, 4 = cloud distance. | whole number, `0` – `8` | `0` |
| `clouds.density` | Cloud density multiplier. | `0.0` – `4.0` | `0.60` |
| `clouds.detailfadedistance` | Where detail noise stops being evaluated, in metres. | `100.0` – `200000.0` | `25000.0` |
| `clouds.detailnoisescale` | Detail erosion noise wavelength, in metres. | `10.0` – `50000.0` | `1600.0` |
| `clouds.detailstrength` | How hard the detail noise erodes the base shape. | `0.0` – `2.0` | `0.35` |
| `clouds.detailwindspeedscale` | Detail noise wind speed, relative to the base. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `2.0` |
| `clouds.distancefadestart` | Where clouds start fading out, in metres. | `1000.0` – `500000.0` | `80000.0` |
| `clouds.enabled` | Ray-marched volumetric clouds. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `clouds.extinctionscale` | Extinction per unit density. | `0.0` – `2.0` | `0.05` |
| `clouds.groundbouncescale` | Light bounced from the ground into the cloud base. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.30` |
| `clouds.layerbottom` | Cloud base altitude, in metres. | `0.0` – `20000.0` | `1200.0` |
| `clouds.layerthickness` | Cloud layer thickness, in metres. | `1.0` – `20000.0` | `4000.0` |
| `clouds.lightmarchdistance` | Length of the shadow ray, in metres. | `10.0` – `20000.0` | `1600.0` |
| `clouds.lightsteps` | Steps along the shadow ray towards the sun. | whole number, `1` – `32` | `6` |
| `clouds.maxsteps` | Primary ray-march steps. Quality vs cost of the cloud ray march. | whole number, `8` – `512` | `96` |
| `clouds.maxtracedistance` | Longest primary ray, in metres. | `1000.0` – `500000.0` | `120000.0` |
| `clouds.ms.extinctionfalloff` | Extinction falloff per octave. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.55` |
| `clouds.ms.phasefalloff` | Phase falloff per octave. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.50` |
| `clouds.ms.scatterfalloff` | Scatter falloff per multiple-scattering octave. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.55` |
| `clouds.multiscatteroctaves` | Multiple-scattering octaves. Approximates light bouncing many times inside thick clouds; more octaves brighten their interiors. | whole number, `1` – `8` | `3` |
| `clouds.phaseblend` | Blend between the two phase lobes. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.28` |
| `clouds.phaseg0` | Forward-scattering lobe. How strongly clouds glow when looking towards the sun. | `-0.99` – `0.99` | `0.80` |
| `clouds.phaseg1` | Back-scattering lobe. How much light scatters back towards the sun side. | `-0.99` – `0.99` | `-0.25` |
| `clouds.planetradiuskm` | Planet radius in kilometres; sets the curvature of the layer. | `100.0` – `20000.0` | `6360.0` |
| `clouds.powderstrength` | Powder (dark-edge) approximation strength. | `0.0` – `2.0` | `0.35` |
| `clouds.resolutiondivisor` | Renders clouds at 1/N resolution. | whole number, `1` – `8` | `2` |
| `clouds.scattering.b` | Cloud scattering albedo, blue. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `1.0` |
| `clouds.scattering.g` | Cloud scattering albedo, green. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `1.0` |
| `clouds.scattering.r` | Cloud scattering albedo, red. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `1.0` |
| `clouds.shadowconespread` | Cone spread of the shadow ray. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.12` |
| `clouds.shadowstepgrowth` | Step growth along the shadow ray. | `1.0` – `4.0` | `1.35` |
| `clouds.sunintensityscale` | Multiplier on sunlight reaching the clouds. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `1.0` |
| `clouds.temporalblend` | Weight of cloud history; higher is smoother and laggier. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.92` |
| `clouds.temporalupsampling` | Reprojects previous frames to fill the low-resolution trace. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `clouds.weathercellsize` | Weather-map cell size multiplier. | `0.01` – `10.0` | `1.0` |
| `clouds.weathercoveragebias` | Added to the weather map's coverage. | `-1.0` – `1.0` | `0.0` |
| `clouds.weatherscale` | Weather-map wavelength, in metres. | `1000.0` – `500000.0` | `90000.0` |
| `clouds.weatherseed` | Seed for the procedural weather map. | whole number, `0` – `1000000` | `1337` |
| `clouds.weathertypebias` | Added to the weather map's cloud type. | `-1.0` – `1.0` | `0.0` |
| `clouds.winddirection` | Cloud wind heading, in degrees. | `-360.0` – `360.0` | `45.0` |
| `clouds.windskew` | How much the wind leans the column with altitude. | `0.0` – `2.0` | `0.35` |
| `clouds.windspeed` | Cloud wind speed, m/s. | `0.0` – `200.0` | `12.0` |

## Shadows (virtual, point-light and ray-traced)

How it works: [8. Shadows](08-Shadows.md).

| CVar | What it does | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow.point.bias` | Constant depth bias. Raise it if point-light shadows show stripes (acne); lower it if they detach from objects. | `0.0` – `0.1` | `0.002` |
| `shadow.point.debugview` | Point-shadow debug visualisation. | whole number, `0` – `4` | `0` |
| `shadow.point.filterradius` | PCF radius in texels. Softness of point-light cubemap shadows (only used when the virtual shadow map is off for lights). | whole number, `0` – `8` | `2` |
| `shadow.point.mapsize` | Cube face resolution. Changing this rebuilds the shadow atlas. | whole number, `128` – `4096` | `1024` |
| `shadow.point.normaloffset` | Offsets the lookup along the normal, in texels. | `0.0` – `16.0` | `1.0` |
| `shadow.point.seamblenddistance` | Blend width across cube-face seams. | `0.0` – `1.0` | `0.05` |
| `shadow.point.slopescaleddepthbias` | Depth bias proportional to the surface slope. | `0.0` – `16.0` | `2.0` |
| `shadow.rt.debugview` | 1 sun visibility, 2 raw sun rays, 3 local light visibility, 4 raw local light rays. | whole number, `0` – `4` | `0` |
| `shadow.rt.enabled` | Ray-traced sun shadows instead of the shadow map. | `true` / `false` | `false` |
| `shadow.rt.filterradius` | Widest sun penumbra blur, in pixels. | whole number, `0` – `16` | `8` |
| `shadow.rt.lightsoftness` | Multiplier on local lights' emitter size for their shadows. | `0.0` – `4.0` | `1.0` |
| `shadow.rt.locallights` | Also ray trace point, spot and rect light shadows (8 per pixel). Lights beyond 8 on a pixel keep their shadow maps. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `shadow.rt.maxraylength` | Longest sun shadow ray, in metres. | `1.0` – `10000.0` | `500.0` |
| `shadow.rt.raybias` | Ray origin offset along the normal, in metres. It grows on its own where light grazes a surface. | `0.0` – `0.5` | `0.01` |
| `shadow.rt.raysperpixel` | Shadow rays per pixel per light per frame. More rays, less noise, more cost. | whole number, `1` – `8` | `1` |
| `shadow.rt.sunsize` | Sun angular diameter in degrees (real sun ~0.53); 0 = hard. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.53` |
| `shadow.rt.temporalblend` | Weight of the current frame in the sun shadow history. Lower is smoother but lags behind moving objects. | `0.02` – `1.0` | `0.1` |
| `shadow.vsm.bias` | Receiver depth bias, in texels. | `0.0` – `16.0` | `1.0` |
| `shadow.vsm.budget` | Only the most important lights cast shadows; off = every shadow-casting light. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `shadow.vsm.budget.fade` | Seconds a shadow takes to fade in or out of the budget. | `0.0` – `5.0` | `0.4` |
| `shadow.vsm.budget.maxlights` | Lights that cast shadows at once under the budget. | whole number, `1` – `16` | `8` |
| `shadow.vsm.cheapfilter` | 2x2 instead of 4x4 shadow filter far away and for the reduced lights. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `shadow.vsm.cheapfilter.distance` | Camera distance beyond which the 2x2 filter is used, in metres. | `0.0` – `1000.0` | `20.0` |
| `shadow.vsm.debugview` | 0 lighting, 1 clipmap level, 2 sun visibility. | whole number, `0` – `2` | `0` |
| `shadow.vsm.depthrange` | Light-space depth kept either side of the camera, in metres. | `10.0` – `100000.0` | `2000.0` |
| `shadow.vsm.enabled` | Shadow the sun (and lights) with the virtual shadow map instead of the single 2K map. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `shadow.vsm.firsttexel` | Finest level's texel size, in metres. | `0.0005` – `0.05` | `0.004` |
| `shadow.vsm.importanceres` | Less important lights read a coarser shadow cube. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `shadow.vsm.importanceres.bias` | Mip bias for the other lights; +1 halves the resolution. | `0.0` – `3.0` | `1.0` |
| `shadow.vsm.importanceres.full` | Most important lights kept at full shadow resolution. | whole number, `0` – `16` | `4` |
| `shadow.vsm.levels` | Clipmap levels in use. How far sun shadows reach: each level doubles the area covered. | whole number, `1` – `16` | `13` |
| `shadow.vsm.lightresolutionbias` | Local-light cube mip bias; +1 halves the resolution. | `-2.0` – `3.0` | `0.0` |
| `shadow.vsm.locallights` | Shadow point, spot and rect lights through the virtual shadow map instead of the cubemap atlas. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `shadow.vsm.nocache` | Re-render every page in use every frame. | `true` / `false` | `false` |
| `shadow.vsm.normaloffset` | Receiver normal offset, in texels. | `0.0` – `8.0` | `1.5` |
| `shadow.vsm.pagesperframe` | Most pages rendered per frame. | whole number, `1` – `240` | `160` |
| `shadow.vsm.poolpages` | Physical 128x128 pages. Changing this rebuilds the pool. | whole number, `256` – `4096` | `2048` |
| `shadow.vsm.resolutionbias` | Clipmap level bias; +1 halves the resolution. | `-2.0` – `3.0` | `0.0` |
| `shadow.vsm.rotationthreshold` | Sun rotation in degrees that re-renders the pages. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.1` |
| `shadow.vsm.slopebias` | Caster slope-scaled depth bias. | `0.0` – `16.0` | `2.0` |
| `shadow.vsm.soft` | Soft shadows (PCSS) for the sun and local lights; off = the fixed 4x4 filter. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `shadow.vsm.soft.lightsoftness` | Multiplier on local lights' emitter size for their shadows. | `0.0` – `8.0` | `1.0` |
| `shadow.vsm.soft.maxpenumbra` | Widest penumbra kept, in metres. | `0.05` – `4.0` | `0.6` |
| `shadow.vsm.soft.minlightsize` | Emitter radius assumed for smaller lights, in metres; 0 keeps them hard. | `0.0` – `0.5` | `0.03` |
| `shadow.vsm.soft.sunsize` | Sun angular diameter in degrees (real sun ~0.53); 0 = hard. | `0.0` – `10.0` | `0.53` |
| `shadow.vsm.terrain` | Terrain casts into the virtual shadow map. | `true` / `false` | `true` |
| `shadow.vsm.terraindisplacement` | Terrain casts tessellated and displaced (expensive). | `true` / `false` | `false` |
